## Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have removed all debug code (`console.log`, `dd()`, `var_dump`)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets/credentials in code
- [ ] No `TODO` or `FIXME` left without an issue reference

### Security
- [ ] No API keys, passwords, or secrets are hardcoded
- [ ] All user input is properly validated/sanitized
- [ ] PostgreSQL queries are safe (no raw injection vulnerabilities)

### UI/UX (if applicable)
- [ ] The change follows our Design Language (Premium Modern)
- [ ] Dark and light mode both look correct
- [ ] Responsive at 390px, 768px, and 1280px
- [ ] Accessibility: keyboard navigable, proper ARIA labels
